name: text-scramble
title: Text Scramble
description: Reveals new text from left to right through a scramble of random characters.

useCases: Animating changing headings, labels, or status text through scrambled characters.
limitations: The initial text does not animate. Animation starts when the text prop changes.
requirements: Motion. Update the text prop to animate. Use a monospace font to reduce width shifts. Reduced motion replaces the scramble with a short fade.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/text-scramble.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
